source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned cleanup helper removes each listed path from both the package checksum map and disk, tolerating an absent key or target file. The historical version targets Cargo.toml.orig in source-backed lockfile packages. Accepted code later iterates package directories and targets other excluded metadata paths; the old target list is not current guidance. Vendor calls cleanup after its policy check, and a separate cleanup subcommand is available. This is not an atomic repair or a verified vendor run. Imported manifest and checksum bodies are excluded.
title: Rust vendor cleanup removes listed files and checksum entries together
